title: Unlocking Africa's Potential with AI — Thabang Ledwaba
talk_summary: This is a motivational keynote about Africa's potential in AI, arguing that mindset and reframing problems (e.g., auto-initiating ID applications instead of queue ticketing) unlock innovation.

takeaways.technique: Reframe the problem before optimizing the process
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of improving an existing workflow (ticketing, more offices), they ask whether the workflow should exist at all — auto-start the process from data already known (birth date → eligibility).
takeaways.evidence_quote: if we know when someone was born and if they qual at an age at which they qualify for an ID why can't we automatically kickstart the process?
